subject.title: fix(llm): summarize ephemeral tool results to preserve prefix cache

question: Should OpenClaw ever replace information-carrying tool results such as `read`, `exec`, web/search, or memory output with fixed placeholders in model-visible provider replay?
rationale: The cache benefit is plausible for heartbeat/status noise, but hiding core tool outputs changes the agent's reasoning inputs and should be deliberately scoped rather than inferred from the linked DeepSeek report.

options.title: Limit placeholders to heartbeat/status outputs
options.body: Use fixed summaries only for low-value control/status tools and keep core tool outputs visible to the model.

options.title: Define a broader explicit policy
options.body: Maintain a documented allowlist with owner approval and regression tests for every tool whose output may be hidden.

options.title: Pause this PR for the canonical design
options.body: Leave the PR open but do not merge until the linked issue has a maintainer-approved tool-result visibility policy and live proof.

recommendation.title: Limit placeholders to heartbeat/status outputs
recommendation.body: Use fixed summaries only for low-value control/status tools and keep core tool outputs visible to the model.
